description: Fetch a Stack Exchange user profile by numeric user ID: reputation, badge counts, answer and question counts, account and last-access dates, and top tags by answer score. Useful for credibility context on an answer author — pass the authorUserId from any question or answer in stackexchange_get_thread output. Returns profile fields plus up to 10 top tags by answer score.

site.description: Stack Exchange site — use the api_site_parameter value (e.g. "stackoverflow", "superuser"). Defaults to "stackoverflow". Call stackexchange_list_sites to discover valid values.

userId.description: Numeric user ID (at most 2147483647) — use the authorUserId field from a question or answer in stackexchange_get_thread output.

name: stackexchange_get_user

answerCount.description: Total number of answers posted when provided by the API.

badgeCounts.description: Badge counts when provided by the API.

creationDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the account was created — the account age.

displayName.description: Display name shown on the site.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `user_not_found`: The user lookup returns an empty result set — SE returns HTTP 200 with no items for unknown user IDs rather than 404. `invalid_user_id`: userId is above 2147483647 — Stack Exchange user IDs are 32-bit signed integers. `invalid_site`: The provided site value is not a valid Stack Exchange network site identifier. `invalid_parameter`: Stack Exchange rejected a request parameter and named the field rather than reporting a bad site. `quota_exceeded`: The Stack Exchange API quota_remaining has reached 0. `invalid_api_key`: Stack Exchange does not recognize the API key this server is configured with. `upstream_unavailable`: Stack Exchange answered with a body that is not the expected JSON envelope. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

lastAccessDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last time the user accessed the site — a stale value means the author is unlikely to respond.

link.description: Direct URL to the user profile.

questionCount.description: Total number of questions posted when provided by the API.

quotaMax.description: Maximum API quota calls per day (300 keyless, ~10,000 with API key).

quotaRemaining.description: Remaining API quota calls for the current day.

topTags.description: Top tags by answer score (up to 10). Empty array for new users with no answers.

items.description: A tag the user has answered in, with answer count and score.

answerCount.description: Number of answers in this tag.

answerScore.description: Total answer score in this tag.

userId.description: Numeric user ID on this Stack Exchange site.

title: Get Stack Exchange User Profile
